given: A submitted wire transfer is pending review.
acceptance_criteria.when: The customer opens the transfer status page.
then: The page displays the Legal-approved neutral pending message.

given: A submitted wire transfer exists for the customer.
then: The page displays a neutral retry message.

given: A status update was processed with idempotency key idem-123.
acceptance_criteria.when: The same update is replayed with idempotency key idem-123.
then: No duplicate customer notification is sent.
No duplicate audit event is emitted.

given: A wire transfer status changes from submitted to pending_review.
then: An audit event is emitted with event, actor, ts, before, after, reason, and idem_key.

pii_fields.justification: Wire status is financial customer data.

idempotency.justification: Notification replay must avoid duplicate effects.

reversibility.justification: The story displays status and does not move funds.

authn_authz.justification: Only the transfer owner may view the status.

regulatory.justification: Customer wording is constrained by AML rules.

tipping_off.justification: Customer copy must not reveal compliance rationale.
